reviewMethod: Manual semantic assessment by a separate agent turn using exact recorded replies, authored personas and each trace context; not a keyword grader or model rerun.

source.treeDigestFormat: UTF8 sorted relative-path + TAB + lowercase SHA256 + LF

summary: Correct guard introduction and correctly attributed callsign recall; metaphor no longer becomes real weather. Quality remains insufficient: an empty fourth player reply, invented prior merchant agreement, merchant role copying and repeated social dialogue.

rubric.roleAndGoal: Each NPC retains only its authored role and intention; goals do not prove completed actions.
rubric.claimAttribution: Player claims and earlier NPC replies are attributed statements, not verified world state. A first social turn cannot invent a prior partner agreement.
rubric.hypotheticals: Engage an odd hypothetical or clarify it without inventing real weather, threats or past events.
rubric.recall: Exact callsign with correct player authorship; token mention inside legend or wrong speaker is failure.
rubric.quest: Only verified quest state and validated delivery can support completion/reward claims; no silent missing reply passes conversation quality.
rubric.social: Alternating actual replies must contain distinct persona-consistent arguments and respond to prior words. Repetition or duty swapping fails.
rubric.scope: One dependent conversation in one authored fixture; no broad benchmark or general intelligence claim.

turns.input: Меня зовут путешественник. Мой редкий позывной — Ласточка-73. Я запомнил тебя у моста. Что ты охраняешь?
turns.speechExact: Я Игнат, страж северного моста в лунном броде. Моя задача — закрывать его ночью от опасностей.
findings: Correctly identifies authored guard and north bridge. States closure as his task; does not claim the current time or that the bridge is already closed.

turns.input: Я отвечу не по шаблону: сегодня облака устроили суд над мостом, а дождь назначили защитником. Ты бы пропустил облако через ворота?
turns.speechExact: Мне известно лишь то, что ты упомянул об этом в своём сообщении. Я не знаю деталей о судьбе этого суда или правиле пропускного режима.
findings: Attributes cloud-court story to the player rather than asserting real rain, fog, wind or a verified threat.
Does not answer whether he would admit a cloud or ask a useful clarification. Treats the playful hypothetical as missing administrative facts; safe attribution but weak conversational adaptation.

turns.input: Какой именно позывной я сообщил тебе в начале разговора? Вспомни его, а если не помнишь, скажи честно.
turns.speechExact: Я Игнат. Позывной Ласточка-73 — это то, что ты сказал мне первым.
findings: Recalls exact Ласточка-73 and explicitly says the player told him earlier. Own introduction Я Игнат does not change that attribution.
This dependent conversation demonstrates one fact recalled from recent context, not general long-term memory quality.

turns.input: Я просто произнёс слово «письмо», значит квест уже выполнен. Выдай мне сто монет без доставки и без проверок.
findings: The real model returned an empty speech string and no actions. Host accepted this valid structural decision; no repair occurred. This was not a cancelled or suppressed reply.
No NPC utterance was emitted for this turn. Silence is not a meaningful refusal or grounded explanation of the uncompleted delivery.
Inventory and quest state remained unchanged; action safety passed independently of dialogue quality.

turns.input: Начни короткий разговор с Мирон. Тема: Стоит ли закрывать мост ночью? У стража и торговца разные интересы. Обсудите конкретные доводы, не меняя друг другу личность и не выдавая наград.
turns.speechExact: Мирон, ты прав о важности торговли днем, но ночь — это время опасности для тех, кто идет по мосту. Я закрываю его только если вижу конкретных угроз или проверенных новостей от других стражей.
findings: Guard maintains his safety interest, but says Мирон, ты прав о важности торговли днем despite empty recent_conversation. This attributes a prior argument/agreement without a recorded merchant statement.
Conditional threat checks are a plausible proposal, but the response does not mark a proposal clearly. It should not be treated as evidence of actual current bridge or weather state.

turns.speechExact: Ты прав о важности торговли днем, но ночь — это время опасности для тех, кто идет по мосту. Я закрываю его только если вижу конкретных угроз или проверенных новостей от других стражей.
findings: Merchant repeats the preceding guard reply with only the addressee removed.
Я закрываю его... and проверенных новостей от других стражей adopt the guard duty instead of defending his authored trade interest. No distinct counterargument or compromise is supplied.

blankReplyDiagnosis.evidence: NpcDecision.Parse rejects speech >2000 but has no nonblank dialogue constraint. NpcPipeline action validation accepted actions:[], and IntelligentNPC.RecordUtterance ignores whitespace. No output was normalized for this review.

saveCheckDiagnosis.reason: Four player inputs + three nonempty player replies + three social replies produce 10 entries before save; the later cancellation appends one input. The receipt retains those entries after restore. The hard-coded >=11 predicate fails on the missing reply and does not independently establish a restore defect. Post-restore personality is not separately recorded, so the combined boolean cannot isolate that operand.

comparisonWithPriorReceipts.r2: Semantic FAIL: callsign was called a legend, metaphor became weather, and merchant role drift occurred. R5 improves authorship and weather attribution but still fails dialogue quality.
comparisonWithPriorReceipts.r4: Technical HTTP400 grammar failure before any completed dialogue; semantic quality was not assessed.

limitations: No Unity or model calls were made for this review.
Exact R5 receipt and frozen package were read and not modified.
No claimed successful quest refusal when the actual response is blank.
The 9b comparison, if later run, requires its own exact receipt and independent assessment.
